'''Eddi''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] for the [[Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children]],<ref name="Mail" /> an orphanage located on the [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] of [[Mek-Sha]],<ref name="A Dash of Kindness">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|A Dash of Kindness|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Mail" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> Eddi gave a toy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] named [[Astahl]], who expressed gratitude, indicating it was unlike anything Astahl had received before.<ref name="Mail" />
